mapper.sql: SELECT i.id, i.activity_id AS activityId, a.creator_id AS activityCreatorId, a.title AS activityTitle, a.category AS activityCategory, a.start_time AS activityStartTime, a.end_time AS activityEndTime, a.place_id AS placeId, p.name AS placeName, i.inviter_id AS inviterId, ui.nickname AS inviterNickname, i.invitee_id AS inviteeId, i.status, i.created_at AS createdAt FROM activity_invite i INNER JOIN activity a ON a.id = i.activity_id INNER JOIN place p ON p.id = a.place_id INNER JOIN sys_user ui ON ui.id = i.inviter_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_invite (activity_id, inviter_id, invitee_id, created_at) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{inviterId}, #{inviteeId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, activity_id AS activityId, inviter_id AS inviterId, invitee_id AS inviteeId, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM activity_invite WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_invite WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND invitee_id = #{inviteeId}
